en.title: The A380 is the biggest, but the Boeing 747-8 holds two world records: longest and fastest airliner
en.summary: The Airbus A380 beats the Boeing 747-8 on wingspan, height, weight and passenger capacity, yet the 747-8 still holds two world records: at 250 feet 2 inches (76.25 meters) it is the longest airliner in service, and at Mach 0.855 it is the fastest. Stretching rather than widening let it keep using standard international gates.
body: The arrival of the Airbus A380 dethroned Boeing as the reigning champion of big jet builders: two full passenger decks running from nose to tail, with the lead in wingspan, tail height, weight and seating capacity. But the 747-8 kept two world records with its stretched fuselage. At 250 feet 2 inches (76.25 meters) from nose to tail, it is over 11 feet longer than the A380 and the longest airliner in service, surpassing the previous record set by the 75.36-meter Airbus A340-600. Its cruise speed of Mach 0.855, about 567 mph, edges out the A380's Mach 0.85 pace and makes it the fastest commercial jetliner flying today. The A380 wins most size contests; the 747-8 holds the length and speed crowns.

The key was Boeing's decision to make the 747-8 longer rather than wider, for one pragmatic reason: airport gates. Because the A380 has such an enormous wingspan, major airports had to widen taxiways and build special two-story boarding bridges just to handle it. Boeing kept the 747-8's wingspan narrower at 224 feet 5 inches, allowing it to pull into standard international gates with minimal airport upgrades. Boeing extended the earlier 747-400 body by 18.3 feet (5.6 meters), adding two extra fuselage sections, one in front of and one behind the wings, to reach 250 feet 2 inches. The comparison table puts the A380 at 485-544 passengers, a maximum range of 8,200 nautical miles (15,186 km) and a maximum takeoff weight of 1,268,000 lb (575,155 kg), against 410-467 passengers, 7,370 nautical miles (13,650 km) and 987,000 lb (447,700 kg) for the 747-8. On speed, the 747-8's Mach 0.855 also beats the A350 and 787 at Mach 0.85 and the 777 at Mach 0.84; the sharply swept wings drawn up in the 1960s to keep pace with supersonic jets, paired with four General Electric GEnx engines, keep it ahead at cruise.

The stretch came at a cost. During early test flights, the longer body and redesigned wings suffered troublesome vibrations along the wingtips, forcing Boeing to reinforce internal structures and rewrite flight-control software. That pushed deliveries more than two years behind schedule and added over $2 billion in program costs, and the new GEnx engines missed their promised fuel-burn targets by 2.7%. The tension exploded in September 2011, when launch customer Cargolux abruptly walked out of delivery ceremonies and refused to accept its first two jets until Boeing and General Electric offered financial discounts. Lufthansa, the only carrier flying both types in significant numbers, keeps all 17 of its 747-8s in Frankfurt for routes to cities like Newark, Tokyo and Johannesburg, while flying its eight A380s out of Munich to Los Angeles and Delhi. Boeing endured nearly $4.2 billion in accounting losses on the 747-8 and built 155 of the stretched aircraft, delivering the last to Atlas Air in January 2023 after more than 50 years of 747 manufacturing; Airbus invested more than $30 billion in the A380 and closed its manufacturing line in December 2021 after just 251 deliveries. With both assembly lines closed, the 747-8 stands alone as the fastest and longest commercial airliner flying today — but its length record has an expiration date. Stretching 251 feet 9 inches (76.7 meters), about 19 inches longer than the 747-8, Boeing's upcoming twin-engine 777-9 is next in line.

zh.title: A380最大、747-8最長最快：空中巴士與波音巨無霸飛機的兩項世界紀錄
zh.summary: 空中巴士A380在翼展、高度、重量與載客量全面勝出，但波音747-8仍握有兩項世界紀錄：全長250英尺2英寸（76.25公尺）是現役最長客機，巡航0.855馬赫則是現役最快客機；加長而非加寬的設計，讓它能使用一般國際航站登機門。
body: 空中巴士A380問世時終結了波音在大型客機的霸主地位：雙層甲板從機頭貫通至機尾，翼展、尾翼高度、重量與載客量全面領先。但747-8以加長機身守住了兩項世界紀錄：全長250英尺2英寸（76.25公尺），比A380長約11.5英尺（3.5公尺），是現役最長客機，也超越先前由75.36公尺的A340-600保持的紀錄；巡航速度0.855馬赫（約567英里／時），略勝A380的0.85馬赫，成為現役最快客機。A380在多數尺寸項目勝出，747-8卻在長度與速度兩項保住王座。

關鍵在於波音選擇加長而非加寬。A380翼展龐大，機場須加寬滑行道、興建雙層登機橋才能接待；747-8翼展維持224英尺5英寸，可直接使用一般國際登機門，僅需少量機場改裝。波音將747-400機身加長18.3英尺（5.6公尺），機翼前後各加一段，總長達250英尺2英寸。對照表顯示，A380載客485至544人、最大航程8,200海里（15,186公里）、最大起飛重量1,268,000磅（575,155公斤）；747-8載客410至467人、最大航程7,370海里（13,650公里）、最大起飛重量987,000磅（447,700公斤）。速度方面，747-8的0.855馬赫也勝過A350與787的0.85馬赫、777的0.84馬赫；1960年代為與超音速客機並行而設計的後掠機翼，加上四具GEnx發動機，讓它在巡航時仍能維持優勢。

加長機身也付出代價。試飛時機翼尖端出現震動，波音須強化內部結構、重寫飛控軟體，交付延誤逾兩年、計畫成本增加逾20億美元；GEnx發動機燃油效率未達目標2.7%，進一步侵蝕四發客機對雙發客機的成本優勢。2011年9月，首家客戶Cargolux一度拒收前兩架飛機，直至波音與GE提供折扣才接受。漢莎航空是唯一同時大量營運兩款機型的航空公司，17架747-8駐法蘭克福，飛往紐瓦克、東京與約翰尼斯堡，8架A380駐慕尼黑，飛往洛杉磯與德里。波音在747-8計畫認列約42億美元會計損失，共生產155架，最後一架於2023年1月交付阿特拉斯航空，結束逾50年的747生產；空中巴士在A380投入逾300億美元，2021年12月關閉產線，共交付251架。兩條產線皆已關閉，747-8成為現役最長、最快的客機；但這項長度紀錄有期限，即將問世的777-9全長251英尺9英寸（76.7公尺），比747-8再長約19英寸。
